title: Good size steamer , but light weight, and cheeply made..Made in china. Handles did Not get hot.
text:
Good size steamer , but light weight, and cheeply made..Made in china. Handles did Not get hot.. This is a good size Farberware steamer.
Although cheaply made. All Farberware is made in China, and Thailand for quite a long time now. manufacture by Meyer corp.
This is Not your Mothers Farberware anymore. ( I do have allot of old farberware from my Mother, and it does last forever).
If you want your cookware and knifes to last, do not put any in the dishwasher, even if it says you can. It starts to etish , and peel
Nonstick.
All the old Farberware was made in The USA, and on the bottom it will say USA, and what state it was manufacture.
You can only find the old peices in thrift shops, or ebay.

I do like the size of this one. I steamed a couple of pounds of cut up red potatoes and the steamer was not all filled up.
The lid is glass and fits good.
You can also just use the bottom with without the steamer.
The steamer is stainless, but the bottom mint color pot on the inside is non-stick that says its not PFOA, no Lead or Cadmium.
Although does Not say its BPA free.So there is warnings, if you have pet birds, keep them out of the kitchen, and
Do Not use a high heat.
Oven up to 350 degrees.
It says it is dishwasher safe, but not sure if that is just for the steamer! In the bottom pot , do not use medal spoons in non-stick.
Only use silicone, and wooden spoons.
The handles are a light weight plastic, and did not get hot, which I really liked, although I did not use a high flame

product_metadata.title: Farberware Dishwasher Safe Nonstick Sauce Pot/Saucepot with Steamer Insert with Lid, 3 Quart, Aqua Blue
features: STACK AND STEAM: The dishwasher-safe steamer set features a nonstick aluminum saucepot and stainless steel steamer insert designed for quality cooking performance
QUICK RELEASE: Durable, top-quality nonstick saucepot interior provides easy food release and fast cleanup
MADE TO LAST: The steamer insert features durable, dishwasher-safe stainless steel construction to turn your saucepot into a lobster pot, pasta pot, or versatile veggie steamer
EASY HANDLING: Double-riveted steamer set handles provide a comfortable grip and are oven safe to 350 degrees F
FAST CLEANUP: Steaming pot and insert are dishwasher safe for even more convenience in today's busy kitchens
WATCH WHAT YOU COOK: Shatter-resistant glass lid seals in heat and flavor
description: Stack your healthy cooking up for success with the versatile Farberware(r) Dishwasher Safe Stack 'N' Steam Saucepot and Steamer Set. Great as a lobster pot, pasta pot, or for steaming vegetables or dumplings, this 3-quart saucepot comes with a stainless steel steamer insert for incredible recipe versatility. The saucepot features high-quality nonstick for great food release and a shatter resistant glass lid to seal in heat and flavor. Aluminum construction heats the steaming pot quickly and evenly, handles are double-riveted for strength, and the stacking steamer set is conveniently dishwasher safe and oven safe to 350°F.
